hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative one, one and two, zero. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative one, one to two, one that is labeled three. There is a vertical dotted segment from two, one to two, zero that is labeled negative one.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{1}{3}$.
